picked_rationale.C2: C2 (dose-response steering: amplifying S causally raises encoded-protein alpha-helix fraction) is the core causal claim of the entire research direction and the one whose evidence is most exposed to a measurement-pipeline artifact -- its headline effect is read out entirely through a structure-PREDICTION pipeline (ESMFold->DSSP on generated, never-before-existing sequences), which is exactly the kind of result a method-axis swap (structure predictor or SS-definition swap) can genuinely stress-test. C1's existence claim is already heavily internally cross-validated by M0 (confound controls, BH-FDR, shuffle nulls, seed/helix-def robustness) and pins the substrate for everything downstream, making it comparatively less decisive to swap-test right now. C3 is not eligible this pass (Phase 2 combined = FAIL -> INCONCLUSIVE).
